missions.name: The brand seam runs end to end: intake → apply writes canonical source with a receipt → real build → pixels move
missions.objective: Measured at 1f69c957: brand.apply with apply:true writes tokens.<brand>.<theme>.json, specimens.json and variables.css under artifacts/<date>/review-kit/brand.apply/<ts>/ (packages/mcp-server/src/tools/brand.apply.ts:604-624) while its own plan diff labels the path packages/tokens/src/tokens/brands/<brand>/<theme>.json (:338) and emits '(no-op)' context lines (:349); its 'build' is spawn('pnpm',['run','check:tokens'],{stdio:'ignore'}) resolving on any exit code or spawn error (:461-478), reported only as durationMs (:667-670). The canonical source it already reads (:41-43) is packages/tokens/src/tokens/brands/{A,B}/{base,dark,hc}.json built by node packages/tokens/scripts/build.mjs (package.json:73; scopes in packages/tokens/style-dictionary.config.cjs:69-103) into dist/css/tokens.css (six [data-brand][data-theme] blocks) and dist/css-variables-by-scope.json. brand.intake (24 lines) validates a DTCG envelope in memory, forces apply:false (lib/dtcg-intake/index.ts:155-169, types.ts:41), always returns unresolved-content-reference for the content-addressed operand (index.ts:557-564; no resolver exists), and emits nothing a downstream tool consumes. tokens.build copies tokens.css/tokens.ts/tokens.tailwind.json byte-identical whatever brand/theme say (tokens.build.ts:112-153). fidelity.preview branded-mockup uses a hard-coded hex table for 'brand-a'/'brand-b' and falls back silently to brand-a (codegen/branded-mockup-emitter.ts:78-123) while resolveTokenToColor(token,{brand,theme}) from @oods/viz-core (token-resolver.ts:26-38) already serves dashboard.render.html and certify-contrast. Build: (1) brand.intake: a validated inline-document envelope returns, in addition to the receipt, a deterministic envelopeHash and a `delta` document in the exact shape brand.apply's input.delta accepts (alias strategy or the RFC 6902 add/remove/replace subset), so intake output feeds apply input without hand editing; the content-addressed operand keeps its typed unresolved outcome and its description says no resolver exists (documented-limit); (2) brand.apply apply:true writes the canonical brand source files under BRAND_ROOT (repo default; env override MCP_BRAND_SOURCE_ROOT; never a caller path), records per file sha256 before/after and byte counts in the receipt, then runs the real token build (node packages/tokens/scripts/build.mjs, cwd = the root) with captured stdout/stderr and exit code; non-zero exit is a tool error carrying the last 40 lines and leaves the written files in place with the receipt saying so; the artifacts run directory keeps the transcript, specimens and CSS snapshot as today; '(no-op)' lines appear only for changes with identical before/after and the diff path label equals the file actually written; dry-run (apply false) writes nothing under BRAND_ROOT and the receipt says so; (3) tokens.build: brand/theme return the requested scope's variables (from dist/css-variables-by-scope.json) and a scope-only CSS block alongside the full tokens.css, with the description updated; an unknown brand/theme is a typed OODS-V error, not a default; (4) fidelity.preview branded-mockup derives its colour variables through resolveTokenToColor from the built scopes using the canonical brand ids A/B (brand-a/brand-b accepted as aliases for one release with a deprecation note in the description), unknown brand → typed error; the hex table is deleted; (5) pixels move: a product-reality spec at the MCP boundary (literal wire input validated with getAjv against the registered schemas, handlers invoked on a temporary copy of packages/tokens set as MCP_BRAND_SOURCE_ROOT) runs intake → apply (a delta changing brand B's primary colour role) → build, then proves viz_render brand B dark line svgHash differs from the retained Sprint 191/193 matrix row and the SVG contains the new colour, code_generate Subscription/workflow React with options.brand 'B' theme 'dark' emits a shell whose resolved tokens.css [data-brand='B'][data-theme='dark'] block carries the new value, and one governed component root rendered through the existing six-cell theme harness changes its measured colour in the B/dark cell; the retained receipt under artifacts/product-reality/sprint-194/m02/ holds the three before/after pairs; (6) the s193 caveats for brand.apply:461/:622, brand.intake:8, tokens.build:141 and branded-mockup-emitter:78 are re-derived by s193-tool-truth.mjs as either gone or kind documented-limit, and existing contract specs (brand.apply.patch.spec.ts, brand.intake.s181.spec.ts, portable-boundary.s181.spec.ts) are updated in this mission with the reason where a pinned fact changed.
